Name: Improper Session Management
Description: The product does not properly manage user-related sessions such as setting appropriate configurations and settings for sessions on creation and handling sessions throughout their lifetime.

PotentialMitigations.Description: Very carefully manage user authenticated sessions. Ensure that appropriate timeouts, invalidation procedures, and protections are established.

ObservedExamples.Description: Session was not invalidated after inactivity
Chain: log out invalidated the session on the client side (CWE-602), but not the server side (CWE-1464)

References.Title: OWASP Web Security Testing Guide: 4.6 Session Management Testing
